source: Own measurement, 2026-11-23, on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: 12 episodes, one per unit, draw 3 of tests/hidden/episode_selection.json; draws 1 and 2 are void, draw 2 because the grader's budget and log changed) with this build's grader: the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505), ale validate run validate-92bea9ed on a shared x86-64 Linux host (AMD Zen 3, Docker, load about 70): mean_episode_credit 1.0 (the oracle's verification.json), 12 of 12 episodes scored, no simulation faults, the numerics check and the render self-test passed, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 196 of 196 differing; the controller's own time 105 s of the 9000 s budget; the verify stage took 1582 s for the 12 episodes. At the selection every kept episode gave credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire (1593-1825 steps); before the budget change, five validates of draw 2 gave 1.0 in each.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json: 24 candidates tried, 23 kept, the first kept per unit). full_at 0.98: the runs showed no spread; one hinge's pin missing in one episode (0.25 of one episode, 0.021 of the metric) still leaves the reference at reward 1.0 after the engine's rounding.
